title: Extract specific fields or characters from a file
summary: Use the `cut` command to extract specific columns or characters from a text file. This is useful for pulling out just the data you need from structured files like CSVs or logs.

steps.explain: Extract specific characters (e.g., 5th to 10th) from each line of a file.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the text file you want to process

alternatives.explain: Extract specific fields (columns) separated by a delimiter (default is TAB).
